words.enDefinition: a shop selling food and everyday household items

examples.en: I stop at the grocery store near campus twice a week.
examples.zh: 我每周去学校附近的「杂货店」两次。

examples.en: The grocery store on Fifth Street closes at eleven tonight.
examples.zh: 第五街的「杂货店」今晚十一点关门。

words.enDefinition: a small shop open long hours selling snacks and basics

examples.en: Grab some snacks at the convenience store across from the dorm.
examples.zh: 去宿舍对面的「便利店」买点零食吧。

examples.en: The convenience store near my apartment is open twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 我公寓附近的「便利店」二十四小时营业。

words.enDefinition: a small neighborhood shop on a street corner

examples.en: Our corner store sells fresh fruit and cheap instant noodles.
examples.zh: 我们的「街角小店」卖新鲜水果和便宜的泡面。

examples.en: I grab milk at the corner store on my way home.
examples.zh: 回家路上我在「街角小店」顺带买了牛奶。

words.enDefinition: an open market where local farmers sell fresh produce

examples.en: The farmers market downtown sells fresh vegetables every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 市中心的「农贸市场」每周六早上卖新鲜蔬菜。

examples.en: We bought homemade bread and berries at the farmers market.
examples.zh: 我们在「农贸市场」买了自制面包和浆果。

words.enDefinition: a shop selling donated secondhand clothes and goods cheaply

examples.en: I found a nearly new winter coat at the thrift store.
examples.zh: 我在「二手商店」淘到一件几乎全新的冬衣。

examples.en: Thrift stores near campus are perfect for cheap Halloween costumes.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「二手商店」是买便宜万圣节服装的好地方。

words.enDefinition: a shop selling tools and home repair supplies

examples.en: I went to the hardware store to buy hooks for my posters.
examples.zh: 我去「五金店」买挂海报用的挂钩。

examples.en: The hardware store downtown also rents power tools on weekends.
examples.zh: 市中心的「五金店」周末还出租电动工具。

words.enDefinition: a shop that sells flowers and arrangements

examples.en: I ordered a small bouquet at the florist for my host mom.
examples.zh: 我在「花店」给寄宿妈妈订了一小束花。

examples.en: The florist next to the bakery sells single roses cheaply.
examples.zh: 面包店旁边的「花店」单支玫瑰卖得便宜。

words.enDefinition: a shop licensed to sell beer, wine, and spirits

examples.en: You must show ID when buying beer at the liquor store.
examples.zh: 在「酒类专卖店」买啤酒必须出示证件。

examples.en: There is a liquor store two blocks from our apartment.
examples.zh: 我们公寓两个街区外有一家「酒类专卖店」。

collocations: show ID at the liquor store

words.enDefinition: a large enclosed building with many shops and restaurants

examples.en: The shopping mall downtown has a cinema and a huge food court.
examples.zh: 市中心的「购物商场」里有电影院和一个超大的美食广场。

examples.en: We spent all Saturday afternoon wandering around the new shopping mall.
examples.zh: 我们整个周六下午都在那家新开的「购物商场」里闲逛。

words.enDefinition: an outdoor retail area with several attached stores

examples.en: Our shopping center has a supermarket, a bank, and a pharmacy.
examples.zh: 我们的「购物中心」里有超市、银行和药房。

examples.en: The new shopping center opened with a big discount store.
examples.zh: 新开的「购物中心」带了一家大型折扣店。

words.enDefinition: a row of shops sharing a parking lot

examples.en: Our favorite ramen place is hidden in a small strip mall.
examples.zh: 我们最爱的拉面店就藏在一片小「沿街商铺区」里。

examples.en: Most of the strip malls along this road offer free parking.
examples.zh: 这条路沿线的「沿街商铺区」大多提供免费停车。

words.enDefinition: a discount shop selling cheap everyday items

examples.en: I buy party cups and tape at the dollar store.
examples.zh: 我在「平价商店」买派对纸杯和胶带。

examples.en: Everything in that dollar store costs only a few dollars.
examples.zh: 那家「平价商店」里的东西只卖几美元。

words.enDefinition: an area with many fast food stalls sharing seating

examples.en: Let's meet at the food court on the second floor.
examples.zh: 我们在二楼的「美食广场」碰面吧。

examples.en: The mall food court has dumplings, burritos, and bubble tea.
examples.zh: 商场的「美食广场」有饺子、墨西哥卷饼和奶茶。

words.enDefinition: a vehicle that sells meals on the street

examples.en: A taco food truck parks outside the library at lunchtime.
examples.zh: 午餐时间一辆塔可「流动餐车」会停在图书馆外。

examples.en: The food trucks parked near campus are cheaper than most restaurants.
examples.zh: 校园附近停着的「流动餐车」比大多数餐馆便宜。

collocations: grab lunch from a food truck

words.enDefinition: a window where customers order without leaving the car

examples.en: We grabbed coffee at the drive-thru before our morning lecture.
examples.zh: 上早课前我们先在「免下车窗口」买了咖啡。

examples.en: The pharmacy has a drive-thru window for picking up prescriptions.
examples.zh: 那家药房设有「免下车窗口」，不用下车就能取药。

words.enDefinition: a shop that sells fresh bread and pastries

examples.en: The little bakery around the corner sells amazing cinnamon rolls.
examples.zh: 街角那家小「面包店」卖的肉桂卷特别好吃。

examples.en: I pick up fresh bread from the bakery on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我每周日都会去「面包店」买新鲜面包。

words.enDefinition: a shop selling sandwiches, cold cuts, and prepared foods

examples.en: The deli near campus makes huge sandwiches for under eight dollars.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「熟食店」八美元以内就能买到超大三明治。

examples.en: I grabbed potato salad and cold cuts at the deli counter.
examples.zh: 我在「熟食店」柜台买了土豆沙拉和切片冷肉。

words.enDefinition: a shop that sells fresh cuts of meat

examples.en: The butcher shop downtown sells better meat than the supermarket.
examples.zh: 市中心的「肉铺」卖的肉比超市好。

examples.en: Ask the butcher shop to cut the pork into thin slices.
examples.zh: 可以请「肉铺」把猪肉切成薄片。

words.enDefinition: a casual cafe serving coffee drinks and light snacks

examples.en: We study at the coffee shop next to the library every Friday.
examples.zh: 每周五我们都在图书馆旁边的「咖啡店」学习。

examples.en: This coffee shop offers a student discount with your ID card.
examples.zh: 这家「咖啡店」凭学生证可以享受折扣。

words.enDefinition: a shop that sells new and used books

examples.en: I sold my old textbooks back to the campus bookstore.
examples.zh: 我把旧课本卖回给了校园「书店」。

examples.en: The independent bookstore downtown hosts author events on most weekends.
examples.zh: 市中心那家独立「书店」大多数周末都办作家分享活动。

words.enDefinition: a city library anyone can use for free

examples.en: The public library downtown offers free printing and quiet study rooms.
examples.zh: 市中心的「公共图书馆」提供免费打印和安静的自习室。

examples.en: You can borrow movies from the public library with a free card.
examples.zh: 办一张免费借书证就能在「公共图书馆」借电影碟片。

words.enDefinition: a charity that gives free groceries to people in need

examples.en: The neighborhood food pantry offers groceries on Saturday mornings in the building behind the library.
examples.zh: 社区「食品救济站」周六上午发放食品，地点在图书馆后面的楼里。

examples.en: Our neighbors collected sealed packages of rice for the food pantry during the winter drive.
examples.zh: 冬季募捐活动中，邻居们收集了未开封的大米，准备送给「食品救济站」。

words.enDefinition: a self-service shop with coin-operated washing machines

examples.en: Our dorm has no washers, so I use the laundromat downtown.
examples.zh: 宿舍没有洗衣机，所以我用市中心的「自助洗衣店」。

examples.en: Remember to bring quarters because the laundromat machines only take coins.
examples.zh: 记得带硬币，因为「自助洗衣店」的机器只收硬币。

words.enDefinition: a shop that cleans clothes with chemical solvents

examples.en: Take your suit to the dry cleaner before the career fair.
examples.zh: 求职招聘会之前把西装拿到「干洗店」洗一下。

examples.en: The dry cleaner near campus removed the coffee stain completely.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「干洗店」把咖啡渍完全去掉了。

collocations: drop off at the dry cleaner

words.enDefinition: a government office handling mail, packages, and stamps

examples.en: I mailed my tax forms at the post office on Monday.
examples.zh: 我周一在「邮局」寄出了报税表格。

examples.en: The post office sells boxes and tape for shipping packages.
examples.zh: 「邮局」卖寄包裹用的纸箱和胶带。

collocations: ship a package at the post office

words.enDefinition: a public box where outgoing mail is collected

examples.en: Drop your letters in the blue mailbox across from the cafe.
examples.zh: 把信投进咖啡店对面的蓝色「邮筒」。

examples.en: The mailbox on our street gets emptied every weekday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们街上的「邮筒」每个工作日下午都会被清空。

collocations: mail a letter in the mailbox

words.enDefinition: a local office of a bank for in-person service

examples.en: I opened my checking account at a bank branch near campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校附近的一家「银行分行」开了支票账户。

examples.en: The bank branch closes at five, so go before class ends.
examples.zh: 那家「银行分行」五点关门，所以要在下课前赶过去。

words.enDefinition: a business where professionals cut and style hair

examples.en: I booked a haircut at the hair salon near the campus gate.
examples.zh: 我在学校门口的「美发店」预约了剪发。

examples.en: That hair salon gives student discounts on weekday mornings before ten.
examples.zh: 那家「美发店」工作日上午十点前对学生打折。

words.enDefinition: a shop where barbers cut men's hair

examples.en: My roommate gets a fade at the barbershop every three weeks.
examples.zh: 我室友每三周去「理发店」剪一次渐变发型。

examples.en: The barbershop next to campus accepts walk-ins on most weekdays.
examples.zh: 校园旁的「理发店」大多数工作日可以随到随剪。

words.enDefinition: a place where vehicles are cleaned inside and out

examples.en: The automatic car wash near campus costs twelve dollars per wash.
examples.zh: 学校附近的自动「洗车场」洗一次十二美元。

examples.en: Wash the salt off your car at the car wash in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天要在「洗车场」把车上的融雪盐洗掉。

words.enDefinition: a garage where mechanics fix car problems

examples.en: The auto repair shop quoted me two hundred for new brakes.
examples.zh: 「汽车修理厂」给我换刹车片的报价是两百美元。

examples.en: My roommate recommends the auto repair shop near the stadium.
examples.zh: 我室友推荐体育馆附近那家「汽车修理厂」。

words.enDefinition: a place where drivers refuel their cars

examples.en: Fill up at the gas station off Exit 5 because it's cheaper.
examples.zh: 在五号出口的「加油站」加油，那边更便宜。

examples.en: Most gas stations here let you pay at the pump.
examples.zh: 这里的多数「加油站」可以直接在油泵边刷卡。

words.enDefinition: a rented room for storing personal belongings off-site

examples.en: We rented a storage unit for our stuff over the summer.
examples.zh: 暑假我们把东西放进租的「自助仓库」。

examples.en: A small storage unit costs about sixty dollars a month here.
examples.zh: 这里一个小型「自助仓库」每月大约六十美元。

words.enDefinition: a facility where residents drop off recyclable materials

examples.en: Take your empty bottles to the recycling center on Elm Street.
examples.zh: 把空瓶子送到榆树街的「废品回收站」。

examples.en: The city recycling center accepts electronics on the first Sunday.
examples.zh: 市「废品回收站」每月第一个周日回收电子产品。

collocations: drop off at the recycling center

words.enDefinition: a public building offering local activities and services

examples.en: The community center near my apartment offers free yoga classes.
examples.zh: 我公寓附近的「社区中心」提供免费瑜伽课。

examples.en: We rent a room at the community center for club meetings.
examples.zh: 我们在「社区中心」租了个房间开社团例会。

words.enDefinition: the store area with fresh fruits and vegetables

examples.en: The produce section at our supermarket gets fresh stock every morning.
examples.zh: 我们超市的「蔬果区」每天早上都会上新货。

examples.en: Pick your own vegetables in the produce section near the entrance.
examples.zh: 在入口旁边的「蔬果区」自己挑蔬菜。

words.enDefinition: a passage between shelves in a supermarket

examples.en: Canned tomatoes are in aisle five, next to the pasta.
examples.zh: 番茄罐头在「5号货架通道」，就在意面旁边。

examples.en: Our cart got stuck behind another shopper in a narrow aisle.
examples.zh: 我们的购物车在狭窄的「货架通道」里被别的顾客堵住了。

words.enDefinition: a machine letting shoppers scan and pay without a cashier

examples.en: Most of the self-checkout machines accept cards, coins, and phone payments.
examples.zh: 大多数「自助结账机」都支持刷卡、硬币和手机支付。

examples.en: Use the self-checkout lane if you only bought a few items.
examples.zh: 东西买得少就走「自助结账」通道。

words.enDefinition: the queue where shoppers pay for their items

examples.en: The checkout line gets really long right after work hours.
examples.zh: 下班时间「结账队伍」会排得特别长。

examples.en: We switched to a shorter checkout line near the front.
examples.zh: 我们换到了前面一条更短的「结账队伍」。

words.enDefinition: a wheeled basket for carrying items while shopping

examples.en: Grab a shopping cart because we're buying groceries for the week.
examples.zh: 推一辆「购物车」吧，我们要买一整周的食材。

examples.en: Return the shopping cart to the corral after loading your car.
examples.zh: 装完车要把「购物车」推回停放栏。

words.enDefinition: the service area of a drugstore where prescriptions are filled

examples.en: Ask the pharmacist at the pharmacy counter about drug interactions.
examples.zh: 可以在「药房柜台」向药剂师咨询药物相互作用。

examples.en: Pick up your prescription at the pharmacy counter with your ID.
examples.zh: 带上证件到「药房柜台」取你的处方药。

words.enDefinition: an indoor facility with exercise equipment for workouts

examples.en: The campus gym gets really crowded around six every evening.
examples.zh: 学校「健身房」每天傍晚六点左右特别挤。

examples.en: My membership includes access to any gym in the chain.
examples.zh: 我的会员卡在连锁的任何一家「健身房」都能用。

words.enDefinition: a pool built for swimming and water exercise

examples.en: The hotel swimming pool opens at seven in the morning.
examples.zh: 酒店「游泳池」早上七点开放。

examples.en: Lap swim at the campus swimming pool is free with student ID.
examples.zh: 凭学生证可以免费使用学校「游泳池」的泳道。

words.enDefinition: an outdoor area with swings and slides for children

examples.en: The playground behind our apartment complex finally has new swings.
examples.zh: 我们公寓楼后面的「游乐场」终于装上了新秋千。

examples.en: Kids from the neighborhood gather at the playground after school.
examples.zh: 附近社区的孩子们放学后都聚在「游乐场」。

collocations: take the kids to the playground

words.enDefinition: a fenced park where dogs can play off-leash

examples.en: We take my roommate's dog to the dog park on weekends.
examples.zh: 周末我们带室友的狗去「狗狗公园」。

examples.en: The fenced dog park lets dogs run around without leashes.
examples.zh: 这个有围栏的「狗狗公园」可以让狗不拴绳撒欢。

collocations: take your dog to the dog park

words.enDefinition: a court marked for playing basketball

examples.en: The basketball court next to the dorm is free until ten.
examples.zh: 宿舍旁的「篮球场」晚上十点前免费开放。

examples.en: We play pickup games at the park basketball court on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 周六我们在公园的「篮球场」打野球。

words.enDefinition: a room with lockers for changing clothes

examples.en: Leave your bag in the locker room before swim practice.
examples.zh: 游泳训练前把包放进「更衣室」。

examples.en: The locker room showers at the gym were finally fixed last week.
examples.zh: 健身房「更衣室」的淋浴上周终于修好了。

words.enDefinition: a walk-in clinic for non-life-threatening medical problems

examples.en: I twisted my ankle, so I went to urgent care instead of the ER.
examples.zh: 我扭了脚踝，所以去了「急诊门诊」而不是医院急诊室。

examples.en: Urgent care visits usually cost much less than a hospital ER.
examples.zh: 「急诊门诊」的费用通常比医院急诊室低得多。

words.enDefinition: the hospital unit treating sudden serious injuries and illnesses

examples.en: She waited three hours in the emergency room with a broken wrist.
examples.zh: 她手腕骨折，在「急诊室」等了三个小时。

examples.en: Go to the emergency room if the fever won't break.
examples.zh: 如果高烧一直不退，就去「急诊室」。

words.enDefinition: a room where patients or visitors sit before appointments

examples.en: The clinic waiting room was packed, so we waited outside.
examples.zh: 诊所「等候室」挤满了人，我们只好在外面等。

examples.en: Fill out these forms while you sit in the waiting room.
examples.zh: 你坐在「等候室」里时把这些表格填一下。

words.enDefinition: an office that stores items people have misplaced

examples.en: Someone turned my student ID in at the library lost and found.
examples.zh: 有人把我的学生证交到了图书馆「失物招领处」。

examples.en: Check the lost and found in the student union first.
examples.zh: 先去学生会「失物招领处」看看吧。

words.enDefinition: a toilet facility open to everyone in a public place

examples.en: Ask the barista for the key to the public restroom.
examples.zh: 向咖啡师要「公共洗手间」的钥匙。

examples.en: Free public restrooms are available on every floor of the mall.
examples.zh: 商场每一层都有免费的「公共洗手间」。

words.enDefinition: a device in public buildings that provides drinking water

examples.en: Refill your bottle at the water fountain near the stairs.
examples.zh: 在楼梯旁边的「直饮水机」把水瓶灌满。

examples.en: Our hallway water fountain finally has a bottle filling station.
examples.zh: 我们走廊的「直饮水机」终于装上了灌水瓶台。

words.enDefinition: the reception counter where visitors check in

examples.en: Tell the front desk if your room key stops working.
examples.zh: 如果房卡失灵，就告诉「前台」。

examples.en: Leave your package with the front desk if nobody answers.
examples.zh: 没人应门的话，就把包裹交给「前台」代收。

collocations: check in at the front desk

words.enDefinition: a local office where police officers work and take reports

examples.en: Report the stolen bike at the police station with the serial number.
examples.zh: 带上自行车的序列号去「警察局」报失。

examples.en: The police station downtown also runs a neighborhood safety office.
examples.zh: 市中心的「警察局」还设有社区安全办公室。

words.enDefinition: a building where firefighters and fire trucks are based

examples.en: The fire station two blocks away held an open house.
examples.zh: 隔两个街区的「消防站」办了一次开放日活动。

examples.en: Firefighters from the local fire station taught us CPR basics.
examples.zh: 当地「消防站」的消防员教了我们心肺复苏的基础操作。

words.enDefinition: a cinema where films are shown on big screens

examples.en: The movie theater near campus gives discounts on Tuesday nights.
examples.zh: 学校附近的「电影院」周二晚上有优惠。

examples.en: We caught the last show at the movie theater downtown.
examples.zh: 我们在市中心的「电影院」赶上了最后一场。

words.enDefinition: a marked place where buses pick up passengers

examples.en: The bus stop outside the library serves routes 12 and 45.
examples.zh: 图书馆外的「公交车站」停靠12路和45路。

examples.en: Wait at the bus stop because the next bus is due soon.
examples.zh: 在「公交车站」等一下吧，下一班车快到了。

words.enDefinition: a hub where intercity buses arrive and depart

examples.en: The Greyhound bus station downtown is a fifteen-minute walk away.
examples.zh: 市中心的灰狗「长途汽车站」步行十五分钟就到。

examples.en: Buy your ticket online because the bus station closed early.
examples.zh: 网上买票吧，「长途汽车站」提前关门了。

words.enDefinition: an underground stop where passengers board subway trains

examples.en: The subway station nearest my apartment was closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 离我公寓最近的「地铁站」因维修关闭了。

examples.en: Take the escalator down into the subway station and turn left.
examples.zh: 坐扶梯下到「地铁站」，然后左转。

words.enDefinition: a hub where passenger trains arrive and depart

examples.en: We met at the train station an hour before departure.
examples.zh: 我们在「火车站」碰面，比发车早了一个小时。

examples.en: The old train station downtown is now a weekend market.
examples.zh: 市中心的老「火车站」现在变成了周末集市。

words.enDefinition: a main building where passengers board planes or buses

examples.en: International flights leave from the newer terminal, so check your gate.
examples.zh: 国际航班在较新的「航站楼」起飞，出发前确认好登机口。

examples.en: The airport bus stops at every terminal before heading downtown.
examples.zh: 机场大巴在进城前会停靠每一个「航站楼」。

words.enDefinition: a complex where planes take off and land

examples.en: The shuttle to the airport picks up passengers outside the student union.
examples.zh: 去「机场」的班车在学生会大楼外接乘客。

examples.en: Leave for the airport three hours before an international flight.
examples.zh: 坐国际航班要提前三小时出发去「机场」。

words.enDefinition: a marked spot where taxis wait for passengers

examples.en: There is a taxi stand right outside the arrivals hall.
examples.zh: 到达大厅外正好有一个「出租车候客点」。

examples.en: The taxi stand near the hotel charges a flat airport rate.
examples.zh: 酒店旁的「出租车候客点」有去机场的一口价。

words.enDefinition: a multilevel building for parking cars indoors

examples.en: The parking garage under the mall charges five dollars flat.
examples.zh: 商场楼下的「室内停车场」一口价五美元。

examples.en: Keep your ticket because the parking garage validates with store receipts.
examples.zh: 保管好票，因为「室内停车场」凭商店小票能减免停车费。

words.enDefinition: a single marked space where one car parks

examples.en: We circled the block twice before finding a parking spot.
examples.zh: 我们绕了两个街区才找到一个「停车位」。

examples.en: Residents can apply for a reserved parking spot on this street.
examples.zh: 居民可以申请这条街的固定「停车位」。

words.enDefinition: a device that collects payment for street parking

examples.en: Feed the parking meter with coins before you shop downtown.
examples.zh: 去市中心购物前，先往「停车计时器」里投硬币。

examples.en: The parking meter expired, and we got a twenty-dollar ticket.
examples.zh: 「停车计时器」超时了，我们吃了张二十美元的罚单。

words.enDefinition: a road lane reserved for cyclists

examples.en: Always ride in the bike lane, not on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 骑车要待在「自行车道」里，别上人行道。

examples.en: The city added a protected bike lane along University Avenue.
examples.zh: 市里沿大学大道新增了一条带隔离的「自行车道」。

words.enDefinition: a metal frame for parking and securing bicycles

examples.en: Lock your frame to the bike rack, not just the wheel.
examples.zh: 把车架锁在「自行车停放架」上，别只锁车轮。

examples.en: Every dorm entrance has a covered bike rack right outside.
examples.zh: 每栋宿舍门口外面都有带顶棚的「自行车停放架」。

collocations: secure your bike to the rack

words.enDefinition: a marked crossing where pedestrians can safely cross streets

examples.en: Always use the crosswalk and wait for the walking signal.
examples.zh: 过马路一定要走「人行横道」，等行人信号灯亮。

examples.en: In this state, cars must stop for people in the crosswalk.
examples.zh: 在这个州，汽车必须给「人行横道」上的行人让路。

words.enDefinition: a paved path beside a road for pedestrians

examples.en: Biking on the sidewalk downtown is against the city rules.
examples.zh: 在市中心「人行道」上骑车是违反城市规定的。

examples.en: The sidewalk outside our building gets very icy in January.
examples.zh: 我们楼外的「人行道」一月份结冰后非常滑。

words.enDefinition: the point where two streets meet

examples.en: Musicians often perform on the street corner near the square.
examples.zh: 音乐人经常在广场附近的「街角」表演。

examples.en: Meet me on the street corner by the campus bookstore.
examples.zh: 我们在校园书店旁的「街角」碰面。

words.enDefinition: the place where two or more roads cross

examples.en: That intersection near campus is dangerous because cars rarely stop.
examples.zh: 校园附近那个「十字路口」很危险，因为车很少让人。

examples.en: Turn right at the next intersection with the traffic lights.
examples.zh: 在下一个有红绿灯的「十字路口」右转。

words.enDefinition: a circular junction where traffic flows around an island

examples.en: When entering a roundabout, yield to traffic already inside it.
examples.zh: 进「环岛」时要让已经在里面的车辆先行。

examples.en: Take the second exit at the roundabout onto Maple Road.
examples.zh: 在「环岛」走第二个出口，进入枫树路。

words.enDefinition: a bridge carrying one road over another

examples.en: The pedestrian overpass over the highway is closed for repairs this month.
examples.zh: 高速公路上方那座行人「高架桥」这个月封闭维修。

examples.en: We got slightly lost under the overpass near the stadium.
examples.zh: 我们在体育馆附近那座「高架桥」下有点迷了路。

words.enDefinition: a path or road passing underneath another road

examples.en: Use the underpass to cross under the busy railway line.
examples.zh: 走「地下通道」从繁忙的铁路下方穿过去。

examples.en: The underpass near campus floods whenever it rains hard for hours.
examples.zh: 校园附近的「地下通道」一下大雨就会积水。

words.enDefinition: a major multilane road with no traffic signals

examples.en: Take the freeway north and get off at the Fourth Street exit.
examples.zh: 上「高速公路」往北开，从第四街出口下来。

examples.en: Freeway traffic jams are worst here between five and seven.
examples.zh: 这里的「高速公路」五点到七点堵得最厉害。

words.enDefinition: a booth where drivers pay to use a road

examples.en: Slow down as you approach the toll booth on the bridge.
examples.zh: 快到桥上的「收费亭」时要减速。

examples.en: Most toll booths on this freeway accept electronic payment only now.
examples.zh: 这条高速的「收费亭」现在大多只支持电子支付。

words.enDefinition: a roadside stop with parking, restrooms, and food

examples.en: Stop at the rest area halfway through the long drive.
examples.zh: 长途开车中途可以在「高速服务区」歇一下。

examples.en: That rest area off Interstate 90 has clean restrooms and coffee.
examples.zh: 90号州际公路旁那个「高速服务区」卫生间干净，还有咖啡卖。

words.enDefinition: a street with no exit at one end

examples.en: Google Maps led us into a dead end behind the factory.
examples.zh: 谷歌地图把我们导进了工厂后面的「死路」。

examples.en: The street sign clearly marks this road as a dead end.
examples.zh: 路牌清楚地标明这条路是「死路」。

words.enDefinition: a street where vehicles may travel in only one direction

examples.en: Careful, this is a one-way street, so you can't turn here.
examples.zh: 小心，这是条「单行道」，不能在这里转弯。

examples.en: Downtown has many narrow one-way streets, so double-check your route.
examples.zh: 市中心有很多狭窄的「单行道」，出发前再核对一遍路线。

words.enDefinition: the central street of a town with shops

examples.en: Almost every American town has a Main Street with local shops.
examples.zh: 几乎每个美国小镇都有一条开着本地小店的「主街」。

examples.en: The Independence Day parade marches down Main Street every July.
examples.zh: 独立日游行每年七月都会沿「主街」行进。

words.enDefinition: a narrow passage between or behind buildings

examples.en: Our building's trash bins are kept in the back alley.
examples.zh: 我们楼的垃圾桶放在后面的「小巷」里。

examples.en: The shortcut runs through a narrow alley behind the shops.
examples.zh: 这条近路穿过商店后面的狭窄「小巷」。

words.enDefinition: in or travelling to another part of the same town or city

examples.en: I took a bus across town for the evening class at another campus.
examples.zh: 我坐公交去了「城里另一头」的校区上晚课。

examples.en: We found a repair shop across town that stayed open on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 我们在「城里另一头」找到了一家周六也营业的修理店。

words.enDefinition: the parts of a town farthest from the center

examples.en: Their warehouse apartment sits on the northern outskirts of town.
examples.zh: 他们的改建公寓坐落在城市北面的「市郊」。

examples.en: Rents drop sharply once you reach the outskirts of the city.
examples.zh: 一到城市「市郊」，房租就明显降下来。

words.enDefinition: the area of a town where people live

examples.en: Our neighborhood has a laundry, a park, and two cafes.
examples.zh: 我们「社区」有一家洗衣店、一个公园和两家咖啡馆。

examples.en: It's a quiet neighborhood with mostly students and young families.
examples.zh: 这是个安静的「社区」，住的多是学生和年轻家庭。

words.enDefinition: a district with mostly housing rather than businesses

examples.en: Speed limits drop to twenty-five miles in most residential areas.
examples.zh: 大多数「住宅区」的限速会降到二十五英里每小时。

examples.en: The residential area near campus is walkable and safe at night.
examples.zh: 校园旁边的「住宅区」适合步行，晚上也安全。

words.enDefinition: a city area with mainly offices and shops

examples.en: Internships in the business district usually start at nine sharp.
examples.zh: 「商业区」的实习通常九点整开始。

examples.en: The entire business district empties out completely on weekend evenings.
examples.zh: 周末晚上整个「商业区」几乎完全空了。

words.enDefinition: an open public space at the center of town

examples.en: The annual Christmas tree lighting happens at the town square.
examples.zh: 一年一度的圣诞点灯仪式在「城镇广场」举行。

examples.en: Students gather at the town square for the farmers market.
examples.zh: 学生们聚在「城镇广场」逛农夫市集。

words.enDefinition: the building where local government operates

examples.en: You can register to vote at the city hall downtown.
examples.zh: 你可以到市中心「市政厅」登记成为选民。

examples.en: The square outside city hall hosts free concerts every summer.
examples.zh: 「市政厅」外的广场每年夏天都举办免费音乐会。

words.enDefinition: a famous building or site that marks a place

examples.en: The clock tower is the most famous landmark in town.
examples.zh: 钟楼是这个镇上最有名的「地标」。

examples.en: Use that tall church as a landmark so you don't get lost.
examples.zh: 用那座高高的教堂当「地标」，免得迷路。

words.enDefinition: the outline of tall buildings against the sky

examples.en: You can see the whole skyline from the bridge at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时分从桥上能看到整条城市「天际线」。

examples.en: The rooftop terrace overlooks the downtown skyline and the river.
examples.zh: 从屋顶露台能俯瞰「市中心天际线」和河流。

words.enDefinition: a very tall city building with many floors

examples.en: Chicago's skyscrapers look stunning when the evening lights come on.
examples.zh: 傍晚亮灯时，芝加哥的「摩天大楼」美极了。

examples.en: We rode the elevator up a skyscraper for the view.
examples.zh: 我们坐电梯上了一栋「摩天大楼」看风景。

words.enDefinition: a signal controlling vehicle flow at crossings

examples.en: Turn left at the traffic light by the gas station.
examples.zh: 在加油站旁边的「红绿灯」处左转。

examples.en: The traffic light on this street stays green for ages.
examples.zh: 这条街的「红绿灯」绿灯时间特别长。

words.enDefinition: a tall lamp that lights streets at night

examples.en: The old streetlights along this road flicker annoyingly after midnight.
examples.zh: 这条路上的旧「路灯」一过午夜就一闪一闪，很烦人。

examples.en: Wait for me under the streetlight right outside the dorm.
examples.zh: 在宿舍外面那盏「路灯」下等我。

words.enDefinition: a red sign requiring drivers to stop completely

examples.en: Come to a complete stop at every stop sign when driving.
examples.zh: 开车时遇到「停车标志」都要完全停稳再走。

examples.en: The stop sign at this corner is hidden by branches.
examples.zh: 这个路口的「停车标志」被树枝挡住了。

words.enDefinition: a quicker route than the usual way

examples.en: There's a shortcut through the park that saves ten minutes.
examples.zh: 穿过公园有条「近路」，能省十分钟。

examples.en: Don't take that shortcut at night; the lighting is poor.
examples.zh: 晚上别走那条「近路」，灯光太暗了。

words.enDefinition: a lifting cabin that moves people between floors

examples.en: Take the elevator to the fifth floor and turn right.
examples.zh: 坐「电梯」到五楼，然后右转。

examples.en: The elevator in our dormitory building breaks down almost monthly.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼的「电梯」几乎每个月都坏一次。

words.enDefinition: a moving staircase between building floors

examples.en: Stand on the right and walk on the left of the escalator.
examples.zh: 坐「自动扶梯」时靠右站立，把左边留给赶路的人。

examples.en: The mall escalator between floors two and three is broken.
examples.zh: 商场二楼到三楼的「自动扶梯」坏了。

words.enDefinition: a set of stairs inside a building

examples.en: The emergency staircase at the end of the hallway is marked in red.
examples.zh: 走廊尽头的紧急「楼梯」用红色标了出来。

examples.en: Our third-floor walkup apartment has a very narrow wooden staircase.
examples.zh: 我们无电梯的三楼公寓有一段很窄的木「楼梯」。

words.enDefinition: a passage connecting rooms inside a building

examples.en: Your room is the third door down the hallway on the left.
examples.zh: 你的房间在「走廊」左手边第三扇门。

examples.en: Quiet hours apply to the hallways after ten at night.
examples.zh: 晚上十点以后「走廊」里也要保持安静。

words.enDefinition: the floor below ground level in a building

examples.en: Our shared washer and dryer are down in the basement.
examples.zh: 我们公用的洗衣机和烘干机在楼下「地下室」。

examples.en: The basement of our building floods during heavy spring rains.
examples.zh: 春季大雨时我们楼的「地下室」会有点渗水。

words.enDefinition: the storage space directly under a roof

examples.en: Extra winter blankets are stored up in the dusty attic.
examples.zh: 备用的冬被都收在上面落灰的「阁楼」里。

examples.en: My host family turned the attic into a guest room.
examples.zh: 我的寄宿家庭把「阁楼」改成了客房。

words.enDefinition: a raised platform outside an upper-floor window

examples.en: Our tiny balcony fits two chairs and a small table.
examples.zh: 我们的小「阳台」放得下两把椅子和一张小桌子。

examples.en: We usually dry our laundry on the balcony in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天我们通常在「阳台」上晾衣服。

words.enDefinition: a covered entrance area outside a house door

examples.en: We sat on the porch and watched the thunderstorm roll in.
examples.zh: 我们坐在「门廊」上，看着雷雨一点点逼近。

examples.en: The delivery driver left my package on the porch this morning.
examples.zh: 快递员今早把我的包裹放在了「门廊」上。

words.enDefinition: the private outdoor area behind a house

examples.en: We grilled burgers in the backyard for Labor Day weekend.
examples.zh: 劳工节周末我们在「后院」烤了汉堡。

examples.en: Their backyard is big enough for a badminton net and chairs.
examples.zh: 他们「后院」够大，能支起羽毛球网和椅子。

words.enDefinition: the grassy area in front of a house

examples.en: Someone on our street planted tulips all over the front yard.
examples.zh: 我们街上一户人家在「前院」种满了郁金香。

examples.en: Keep the front yard tidy because the landlord checks monthly.
examples.zh: 保持「前院」整洁，房东每个月都会检查。

words.enDefinition: a short private road leading to a house garage

examples.en: Pull into the driveway and park right behind my car.
examples.zh: 开进「私家车道」，停在我车正后面。

examples.en: Don't block the driveway because the landlord needs to leave.
examples.zh: 别把「私家车道」堵住，房东要用车出门。

words.enDefinition: the top outer surface of a building

examples.en: Our dorm rooftop has tables with a view of downtown.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍的「天台」摆了桌子，能望见市中心。

examples.en: The apartment rooftop closes at ten pm for safety reasons.
examples.zh: 出于安全考虑，公寓「天台」晚上十点关闭。

words.enDefinition: an open space surrounded by buildings or walls

examples.en: The library's inner courtyard is perfect for reading between classes.
examples.zh: 图书馆的内「庭院」是课间读书的好地方。

examples.en: Every apartment in the complex opens onto the shared courtyard.
examples.zh: 这个小区每套公寓都通向公共「庭院」。

words.enDefinition: very close, just past the next street turn

examples.en: The coffee shop is just around the corner from the dorm.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡店离宿舍很近，就在「拐角附近」。

examples.en: The bus stop is around the corner, next to the pharmacy.
examples.zh: 公交车站就在「拐角处」，紧挨着药房。

words.enDefinition: a short distance of two city blocks

examples.en: The gym is only two blocks away from our apartment.
examples.zh: 健身房离我们公寓只有「两个街区」远。

examples.en: The laundromat is two blocks away, so carrying loads is easy.
examples.zh: 自助洗衣店离这儿只有「两个街区」，把衣服搬过去很轻松。

words.enDefinition: along the route between two places

examples.en: That convenience store is right on the way to the subway station.
examples.zh: 那家便利店就在去地铁站的「路上」。

examples.en: Pick up your package on the way home from class.
examples.zh: 下课回家「顺路」把包裹取了。

words.enDefinition: a short distance along the same street

examples.en: There's a great ramen place just down the street from us.
examples.zh: 就在我们住处「沿街不远处」有一家很棒的拉面店。

examples.en: He lives just down the street from the grocery store.
examples.zh: 他住在杂货店「沿街不远处」。

words.enDefinition: on the opposite side of the road

examples.en: The pharmacy is right across the street from the campus gate.
examples.zh: 药房就在校园大门「马路对面」。

examples.en: Our neighbor across the street sometimes collects our mail for us.
examples.zh: 「马路对面」的邻居有时会帮我们收信。

words.enDefinition: in the very next building or room

examples.en: The girl next door watered our plants while we traveled.
examples.zh: 我们出门旅行时「隔壁」的女孩帮我们浇了花。

examples.en: The little cafe next door always smells like fresh bread.
examples.zh: 「隔壁」的小咖啡店总是飘着面包香。

words.enDefinition: close enough to reach on foot

examples.en: Everything we need is within walking distance of the dorm.
examples.zh: 我们需要的一切都在宿舍「步行可达」的范围内。

examples.en: Is the gym within walking distance, or should we drive?
examples.zh: 「健身房」走着就能到吗，还是我们得开车？

words.enDefinition: far from any town or populated area

examples.en: Our GPS died, and we were in the middle of nowhere.
examples.zh: 导航突然失灵，我们被困在「前不着村后不着店」的地方。

examples.en: The cabin rental looked great but sat in the middle of nowhere.
examples.zh: 那间出租木屋照片里很美，实际上位于「偏僻之地」。

collocations: lost in the middle of nowhere
cabin in the middle of nowhere

words.enDefinition: in a place few tourists or people visit

examples.en: That ramen shop is a bit off the beaten path but worth it.
examples.zh: 那家拉面店位置有点「冷门僻静」，但很值得一去。

examples.en: We found a tiny bookshop off the beaten path in the old town.
examples.zh: 我们在老城区一条「冷门僻静」的小巷里找到一家书店。

words.enDefinition: directly forward in the direction you face

examples.en: Go straight ahead and the library entrance is on your left.
examples.zh: 「一直向前」走，图书馆入口就在你左手边。

examples.en: The restrooms are straight ahead, just past the information desk.
examples.zh: 洗手间「一直向前」走，过了问询台就是。

words.enDefinition: away from home, visiting another city or area

examples.en: My roommate is out of town until late Sunday night.
examples.zh: 我室友「出城在外」，周日深夜才回来。

examples.en: We went out of town for the long weekend to visit Boston.
examples.zh: 长周末我们「出城」去波士顿玩了。

words.enDefinition: in the rear area of a store or building

examples.en: If the shelf is empty, ask staff to check in the back.
examples.zh: 如果货架空了，可以让店员去「后面」仓库找找。

examples.en: The restrooms are in the back, past the frozen food aisle.
examples.zh: 洗手间在店铺「后面」，过了冷冻食品区就是。

collocations: in the back of the store

words.enDefinition: in the area near this place

examples.en: Do you know a good coffee shop somewhere around here?
examples.zh: 你知道「这附近」哪里有不错的咖啡店吗？

examples.en: Finding parking around here is nearly impossible on weekend evenings.
examples.zh: 周末晚上想在「这附近」停车几乎不可能。
